title: International Payroll Lead
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Lead to own and scale our global payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.
 What You’ll Do:
 Global Payroll Execution & Oversight:
 Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.
 Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.
 Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.

title: Principal, Market & Competitive Intelligence Manager
description:
Role Description
 As the Principal, Market & Competitive Intelligence Manager you will lead Dropbox’s enterprise competitive intelligence program across Dropbox Core, DocSend, Sign and Sign API, and Dropbox Protect.
 Sitting within the Chief Business Officer’s organization, you will work close to the company’s most important strategic and go-to-market decisions. You will build the operating system that turns competitor activity, market developments, customer feedback, win/loss findings, and field signals into clear recommendations and action.
 This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role for a senior individual contributor. You will strengthen Dropbox’s competitive positioning, improve how our teams navigate competitive sales cycles, inform product and go-to-market choices, and deepen executive understanding of a rapidly changing market. Your work will span both sales-led and product-led motions and help Dropbox tell a sharper, more differentiated story.
 You will partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Research, Revenue Operations, Analyst Relations, and Communications. Success requires equal strength in strategic judgment and execution: identifying what matters, developing a defensible point of view, and delivering useful recommendations and tools at the speed of the business.
 Responsibilities
 Lead Dropbox’s enterprise competitive intelligence program across Dropbox Core, DocSend, Sign and Sign API, and Dropbox Protect.
 Establish a company-wide operating model for collecting, prioritizing, analyzing, distributing, and measuring competitive intelligence.
 Translate competitor launches, pricing and product changes, AI developments, customer feedback, and market shifts into actionable recommendations for Sales, GTM Strategy, Product Marketing, Product, and executive leadership.
 Produce decision-ready intelligence—including executive briefings, competitive points of view, rapid-response analysis, battlecards, alerts, and market coverage—tail…

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 À propos d’Anthropic
 La mission d’Anthropic est de créer des systèmes d’IA fiables, interprétables et orientables. Nous voulons que l'IA soit sûre et bénéfique pour nos utilisateurs et pour la société dans son ensemble. Notre équipe est composée de chercheurs, d'ingénieurs, d'experts politiques et de chefs d'entreprise engagés qui travaillent ensemble pour créer des systèmes d'IA bénéfiques.
 À propos du poste
 En tant qu'architecte des solutions partenaires au sein de l'équipe d'IA appliquée d'Anthropic, vous serez architecte avant-vente chargé d'entretenir des relations techniques avec nos intégrateurs de systèmes mondiaux et régionaux (GSI/RSI) et nos partenaires cloud (AWS et GCP). Vous renforcerez nos relations avec les partenaires clés pour accélérer les revenus indirects, permettre leurs pratiques d'IA et exécuter la stratégie GTM à long terme.
 Responsabilités:
 Partenariat technique stratégique : soyez un partenaire de réflexion technique pour l'équipe des partenariats Anthropic GTM, en apportant une expertise technique pour mieux comprendre l'environnement des partenaires, en pilotant des programmes stratégiques clés et en identifiant des opportunités pour approfondir leurs compétences techniques. Vous vous intégrez aux équipes techniques de GSI et des partenaires cloud pour mettre en œuvre leurs pratiques en matière d'IA, vous aider à résoudre les problèmes, promouvoir Anthropic au sein de leurs communautés de développeurs et servir de point d'accès pour les problèmes techniques complexes.

title: Account Executive, Velocity Platforms (Hunter)
description:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 The Platform Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. Platforms already using Stripe include Shopify, Lightspeed and Mindbody.
 As a key member to the Stripe Platforms team, you will manage and elevate relationships with a named account list while identifying new growth opportunities and ways Stripe can exceed expectations.
 What you’ll do
 As an Account Executive (New Business), you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.
 Responsibilities
 Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise companies
 Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating touchpoints with Stripe executives
 Contribute to shaping our platform partnership strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models
 Develop and execute outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities
 Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for Startup, SMB and mid-market platforms
